notes.title: Content Update V1.1 Is Now Live! + Patch Notes
notes.content:
V1.1 is now rolling out across all platforms!

[b]---Patch Notes---[/b]

[i][b]Basic Combat has been added to the game![/b][/i]
Player can now attack and take damage from "Thugs". 
Health is represented by the Three Mail Bags in the corner of the screen. You can also upgrade your health + damage at the Route Me Shop!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999670/fe4870ac2cfac92027ed7601c6a74841d68cad53.gif[/img]

[i][b]New game mode has been added "A Postal Life":[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999670/c2d876a156ababa4c2c3f95ee3352b2cfb562bfd.png[/img]
The rules have been changed. Undertake new routes and explore/unlock "New Haven City HUB".
7 New Routes + 2 Seasonal Variations for each (Snowy/Hell) totaling at 21 New Routes! Unlock new decorative items for your homes that are unique to this mode as well as new upgrades for your postman.

In this mode, delivering mail also has a larger radius, so mail can be thrown in from further away among many other tweaks and changes. If you complete this mode OR classic, you can take your character into the other mode during New Game +. Complete the game mode by earning 3 Promotions!

[i][b]Multiple Difficulties:[/b][/i]
When starting a new file you will be able to now choose between the "Classic/Original" Game or the new "A Postal Life" mode. Each mode has its own difficulty options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999670/c32eaad8bbf5b5ad41af6e59033ab479bc5aa814.png[/img]

[i][b]Mailbox interaction has been improved:[/b][/i] Mailboxes can now be triggered from slightly further away than before in both Classic/Original and also A Postal Life game modes. You can even buy a new upgrade which increases the range even further! (Postal Life Mode Only)

[i][b]New Hub City (A Postal Life): [/b][/i]New Haven City is now open! In-between your main routes, you can now leave the depot and explore a new city! When exploring, enemies, coins and gems will spawn allowing you to stock up on some extra $$$ + more!

[i][b]Random Route (Classic Mode):[/b][/i] A new route has been added to classic mode once collecting all of the Hidden Mail. Mailboxes will spawn in different positions each time the route is undertaken.

[i][b]Fight Me Club:[/b][/i]
Every few days you can undertake the "Fight Me Club" Challenge. Speak to the City Happiness NPC in the Depot. Survive three waves of enemies to collect coins + gems.

[i][b]Debt:[/b][/i]
Your debt can now be paid from the daily results screen

Various bug-fixes and other small tweaks + additions

[b]--END PATCH NOTES--[/b]

notes.title: A Postal Life (V1.1) Update!
notes.content:
Hi Guys!

Just popping in to let you all know the status of update V1.1.
I'm in the very final stages of polishing and getting the update deployed across all systems.

V1.1 will have lots of new additions and features. The main two additions will be basic combat and a new alternative game mode called "A Postal Life". 

I was hoping to initially release the update on all platforms simultaneously but there's a small chance I may have to delay one of the builds by an extra week.

Patch notes and full details will be released once the update has gone live.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Route Me Mail and Delivery Co Coming to Steam 19/08!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I'm happy to announce that Route Me Mail and Delivery Co will be releasing on Steam 19/08/2021!
I just wanted to take a quick moment to share some additional info/links of the game.

Here's some links:

Route Me Mail and Delivery Co Switch Review:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wkrwvk_Vapw

Route Me Mail and Delivery Co Switch Let's Play:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qa5dHEJ34G4

Switch version runs at 30FPS but the Steam version can be configured to 60/120FPS and multiple resolutions. There has also been small adjustments to the timer and a few other mechanics compared to the Switch version, overall, it is the same game functionally.

There is plans for a major content update which will launch simultaneously on all platforms in a few months. I'll have more information to share on that after release.

If you have any questions please feel free to ask them below.

Thanks, everyone!
